grimoires.name: Ulfsild's Contingency

grimoires.name: Traveling Knife
grimoires.description: Throw a knife that can be recalled, striking enemies on the way out and back.

grimoires.name: Wield Soul
grimoires.description: Conjure a soul-bound weapon to strike an enemy and apply an effect.

grimoires.name: Torchbearer
grimoires.description: Raise a torch that burns nearby enemies and can support your group.

grimoires.name: Trample
grimoires.description: Charge forward, damaging and controlling enemies in your path.

grimoires.name: Banner Bearer
grimoires.description: Plant a banner that empowers allies and pressures enemies within it.

grimoires.name: Shield Throw
grimoires.description: Hurl your shield to strike enemies and return to guard you.

grimoires.name: Elemental Explosion
grimoires.description: Unleash an elemental blast whose type follows your focus script.
